title: Chapter 722 - 722 Big Brother; Mission Failed!

Chapter 722 - 722 Big Brother; Mission Failed!

Chapter 722 - 722 Big Brother; Mission Failed!

722 Big Brother; Mission Failed!

All along, Little Rock had been treated like a child.

Now that two new people had arrived, he felt like he had become an adult.

Little Rock brought Li Ke and Qin Menghu to the Path-Understanding Tree and sat down.

When they approached the Path-Understanding Tree, their bodies immediately became ethereal and comfortable.

The energy in his body surged like a river and continued to grow.

Their faces were filled with surprise and fanaticism.

Cultivation…

If he cultivated here, he would definitely… He could definitely become unimaginably powerful at an unimaginable speed!

Little Rock saw the changes in their expressions and wanted to laugh in his heart.

Then, he said,”You guys can cultivate here. In the future, if you encounter any problems, just call me Big Brother. Then, ask.””

In the past, whenever he wanted to ask Lin Yulian about it, she would ask him to call her big sister.

All along, Little Rock had been looking forward to someone asking him questions so that he could be the big brother.

Now, there was finally hope.

Li Ke and Qin Menghu were still overjoyed by the rapid increase in energy in their bodies and did not notice this detail at all.

“Oh right, how should we eat?” Qin Menghu asked.”

Little Rock’s face turned stiff.”

“Ah… Big…Big brother.” Qin Menghu said obediently.

When Little Rock heard this, he immediately smiled and said,””There are many mutated beasts in the Coiling Dragon Villa. There are many spiritual fruits, spiritual trees, spiritual tea, and spiritual rice that can be eaten.”

Monsters?

Spiritual fruit?

Spiritual rice?

Qin Menghu and Li Ke were shocked again.

….

Time flew by like water.

On this day, Lin Fan, who was in the midst of his cultivation, suddenly heard a crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! [You have chosen to give up the mission: Obtained Great Dao Fragment x1, Saint Crystal x1, Transcendence Golden Body x5, Imperial Level Cultivation Technique Upgrade Gem x1.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he broke out into a smile.

“As expected, giving up the mission can also be rewarded. Moreover, the reward is quite good.”

Back when the Universe Competition mission appeared, Lin Fan was still a little hesitant.

The main reason was that the mission rewards were too generous.

From the looks of it, giving up wasn’t a bad idea.

Lin Fan nodded towards the five Transcendence Golden Bodies.

Then, he moved the Saint Crystals and Great Dao Fragments to the Path-Understanding Tree.

“Boom!”

With a soft sound, the ground shook.

The pure energy surged like a tsunami.

Li Ke and Qin Menghu, who were in a state of cultivation, opened their eyes at the same time. Their faces revealed a touch of surprise.

Because, just now…They had all absorbed incomparably pure and enormous energy, allowing their cultivation to advance in one fell swoop.

“Big brother, what happened?”Qin Menghu and Li Ke said excitedly.

“Look at your good-for-nothings!” Little Rock said. Needless to say, Master had broken through!”

When Li Ke and Qin Menghu heard that, they couldn’t help but turn around and look at where Lin Fan was. Their eyes were filled with respect.

….

After Lin Fan woke up from his cultivation state, he did not cultivate again.

Instead, he placed his attention outside the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Now, hundreds of thousands of people had gathered around the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Moreover, the crowd continued to increase as time passed.

Ever since Lin Fan appeared and brought Li Ke and Qin Menghu into the Coiling Dragon Villa, this place had become a true holy land.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan was happy to see this happen.

He used his Heavenly Eye to scan the area and soon, his gaze landed on two men and a woman.

They had decent Death, Metal, and Life talents respectively.

With a flash of his body, Lin Fan appeared in the air.

A powerful aura spread in all directions, as if a king had descended.

Everyone present knelt on the ground in excitement.

With a wave of his hand, Lin Fan sent the two men and one woman who were kneeling on the ground with the others into the air.

“Are you willing to follow me?”

“I’m willing!” The three of them spoke in unison, incomparably excited.

The current Earth had long become a world where the strong were respected.

As for Lin Fan…Without a doubt, he was the strongest person on Earth.

Following Lin Fan was something they had always wanted to do.

Now that it could become reality, how could he refuse?

Lin Fan nodded. With a flash, he brought the three of them into the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Only hundreds of thousands of people were left, still kowtowing.

“Little Rock, I’ll leave them to you to guide.”Lin Fan said.

“Yes, Master!” Little Rock replied happily.”

Lin Fan nodded and returned to his room.

The two men and one woman didn’t hear Lin Fan and Little Rock’s words clearly.

That was because they were all shocked by the dense spiritual energy in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

“What are you three standing there for?” Little Rock raised his head. By the way, what are your names?”

Only then did the three of them react.

“My name is Zheng Cong.”

“My name is Song Wenxuan.”

“My name is Riemann.”

Little Rock nodded.” Alright, I’ll remember you. I’ll teach you a few simple cultivation methods first. If you don’t understand anything, feel free to ask me!” Remember to call me big brother!”

Big brother?

The three of them looked at each other with strange expressions.

However, they still nodded in agreement.

….

After Lin Fan returned to his room, he started to check the character relationships on the system interface.

He wanted to know his family’s situation at all times.

Lin Fan’s face turned cold.

That was because Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian’s names were flashing non-stop.

They… He had encountered danger again.

Moreover, it was extremely dangerous!

This time, the flickering lasted for a full week before it slowly calmed down.

Lin Fan stared at their names for a week.

He waited for another two days before using Soul Communication on Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian.

“Ziqian, Yulian, how are you guys doing?”Lin Fan asked.

When Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian heard Lin Fan’s voice, they were extremely excited.

“Lin Fan!”

“Dad!”

All these years, the two of them had been following Lin Yulian’s guidance in her dream and had been on their way.

Originally, it was considered smooth.

However, when she arrived at the destination in her dream, Lin Yulian realized that the item was gone.

Therefore, she went to the building to buy information.

Who knew…Not long after she asked, she was chased by many demon beasts.

If not for the Emperor grade equipment that Lin Fan had given them, they would have probably died long ago.

When Lin Fan heard that, he immediately made a judgment.

This was probably done by the enemy of the Immortal Phoenix in Lin Yulian’s previous life. After comforting the two for a while, they ended the soul communication.

Then, Lin Fan said,” System, can I curse the person behind Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian?””

[Requires 1 million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

One million spirit stones?

The person behind the scenes was indeed extraordinary.

“Ask!” Lin Fan said.
